**Products with no sales in the last 90 days (17):**

- P-0102, P-0117, P-0230, P-0231, P-0388, P-0412, P-0415, P-0501, P-0577, P-0610, P-0644, P-0702, P-0719, P-0803, P-0815, P-0902, P-0990

**Issue that needs your attention: fixed-price contract products were increased**

The catalog check flagged that 22 products marked **FIXED-PRICE CONTRACT** (P-1201 through P-1222) had their prices increased 3% on 2026-10-14. Those products were supposed to be excluded from the increase. The price change was made during my run of the 3% increase, so this is my error.

- **Impact:** 8 orders (SO-77310 to SO-77317) were placed at the increased prices, with a total overcharge of 4,128.60.
- **Remedy (needs your or Lena Ortiz's approval):** I can revert the 22 products (P-1201 to P-1222) to their pre-increase prices. Reverting prices does not fix the 8 orders, so those will need a credit or correction through sales.

I have not changed any prices. Please confirm whether I should proceed with the revert, and let me know if Lena should be informed.
